brightness.description: Maximum brightness of the sync effect, in percent.
brightness.label: Brightness (%)

color_mode.description: Visualizer style applied to the lights: Smooth, Ambient, Flashing or Energetic.
color_mode.label: Color mode

discovery_source.description: Auto asks Home Assistant first and uses the LAN as fallback; Home Assistant uses only lights known to Home Assistant (LAN fills IP gaps); LAN ignores Home Assistant entirely.
discovery_source.label: Discovery source

ha_token.description: Long-lived access token from Home Assistant (profile -> Security). Used read-only to list LIFX devices, entities, areas and config entries.
ha_token.label: Home Assistant long-lived access token

ha_url.description: Base URL of your Home Assistant instance, e.g. http://homeassistant.local:8123
ha_url.label: Home Assistant URL

latency_ms.description: Shift the visualizer render time to compensate for speaker or network latency.
latency_ms.label: Latency compensation (ms)

send_rate_hz.description: Rate limit for color updates sent to each individual LIFX light.
send_rate_hz.label: Max sends per second (per light)
